title: Consent List — payload
description: A bridge fetches the consent grants it should enforce.

agent.description: Optional. Restrict to grants for this agent VID.

platform.description: Optional. Restrict to this platform tag.

subject.description: Optional. A full subject, to point-check a single conversation.

syncToken.description: Optional. An opaque incremental-sync token from a previous response's `nextSyncToken`; return only grants changed after it. A responder MUST NOT accept a token it did not issue.

Response.title: Consent List — response payload
Response.description: The grants the requesting bridge is authorized to enforce.

nextSyncToken.description: Optional opaque incremental-sync token; pass it back as the request's `syncToken` to receive only grants changed after this response. Omitted, never `null`, when the responder has no token to offer.
